attBesluta.text: This shopping cart is awesome! I often use it to handle work tasks, and its load-bearing capacity easily handles everything. The structure is very sturdy, and it feels like it could last for years. For this price, it's a great value.
Good quality. We had a lot of rain over the summer and there is no rust or problems with the seesaw. Assembled it quickly with the provided tools.
This is a very nice easy to put together sturdy made my granddaughters love it
Good deal for the price. Well built, easy to put together. A little small. Good for six year old.
Bought this for grandkids for a birthday..they all love it! The 14 yr old rides on it with no problems. Would buy again!
We just bought it a few weeks ago and our grandchildren love it.
This is a very well made, sturdy spinning thingamajig. My grandkids love it. This is NOT a cheaply made piece of equipment. Very happy with my purchase.
Foarte multumita. Calitate exceptionala, foarte stabil, copiii il adora. Recomand cu incredere

Currently working on a complete playground for my kids, 3 and 4 years old. this swing easily accomodate my own weight and I like the string they added to facilitate the use for kids. One can sit one side while being counter-weigthed by the string so that the other can also sit. afterwards you pull the pin and they begin playing. really well designed and solid!
My kids really love this and they are 10 and six. Neighborhood kids come over and they have a total blast. Sturdy metal construction. Did fine in Minnesota winter.

We purchased this for our grandsons, ages 3 1/2 and 2 and it was a wonderful addition to the jungle gym we already have for them. The boys love it. When the 2 year old gets on, he loves for us to push him up and down while he holds on for dear life. This seesaw is well built, easy to assemble and it arrived in the time promised. Vevor is a great company, we have purchased many other products and thus far we love, love, love them!

What a great little unit. Super easy to build, all tools provided and is sturdy too. My little boy (almost 2) loves it. I personalised his by painting wooden letters and forest animals to go along the front panel. Really pleased with it!

I like it holds more toys than expected could be more sturdy but its been withstanding my 3 yearold wild child so thats a bonus. Only skipping one star because its soooo light my son was pushing it all over the place and the thing they supplied to attach it to the wall was not great got broken as soon as my son pulled on the toy stand. we ended up using brackets from homedepot to keep it in place
Bien seul bémol les caissons à roulettes. Un peu d'écart entre les planches ne se voit pas avec les jouets mais dommage
I bought it for my grandchild in birthdaypresent, and she was so happy to get it. The transport was fast, the quality is god, and the kitchen was easy to make.

Die Spielküche für draußen ist super. Ich habe eine Plane dazu gekauft deshalb ist sie gut geschützt gegen Regen und Sonne. Der Geruch in den ersten Tagen (da stand die Küche noch drinnen) war allerdings sehr intensiv und unangenehm und bestimmt nicht gerade „gesund“. Deshalb empfehle ich die Küche nur für draußen.
My 7 year old just loves this item. She's a bit tall for it but she plays with it everyday after school. Love it gets her outside playing.

This was very easy to build, but you will want to make sure you are putting the sides and middle bar on the correct sides. The instructions make it look like the sides are equal distance from the center, but they're not. The side that has the bar needs to be on the longer side or the shelves wont match up. Aside from that I didn't have any issues putting this together. The wood is light, and even after its built, its easy to move. I dont know about how well the wood will hold up to the elements, because it does feel like it would absorb moisture, so I plan on putting a coat of clear weather proofing on it.
My wife bought it for our little girl, who loves it. Not sure it's worth the money (their profit margin must be huge 90%?) but if it keeps everyone happy:)
Soft and sturdy unicorn toy. Simple assembly and wheels roll smoothly on hard floors.
Great packaging and quick setup. Smooth ride with well-designed handles.
Sturdy and functions well. Assembly takes some effort but worth the price.
Easy to operate and solidly built. My kid loves this toy.
Great product quality. Arrived early and assembly is easy.
Durable and fun for kids of multiple ages. Great texture and easy to control.
Well-made and tough construction. My child enjoys playing with it very much.
Fully mechanical toy works as expected. Fast assembly, though sharp turns may cause it to get stuck.
